research_question: Does a completed Asian-session XAUUSD range followed by a confirmed M15 close beyond that range during the early London window create enough immediate continuation to survive frozen P75 execution over 30 seconds?
source_basis: MetaQuotes SessionRangeBreakout: XAUUSD M15, overnight Asian range, then London breakout.
Open-source TradingView GOLD Asian Range Breakout: completed Asian high/low and London close outside the range, one signal per direction per day.
Open-source X-Break: Asian range followed by London-session breakout confirmation on completed candle closes.

frozen_signal.range: high/low of completed native-mid M15 bars whose opens fall in 00:00-06:00 UTC
frozen_signal.buy: first completed M15 close above that day's frozen Asian high during 08:00-10:00 UTC
frozen_signal.sell: first completed M15 close below that day's frozen Asian low during 08:00-10:00 UTC
frozen_signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after breakout bar right edge

failure_rule: If the single preregistered common-denominator Asian-range/London-breakout profile fails supply/day or direct-net gate, retire ALRB rather than tune it on Stage-A.
advance_rule: If it passes, freeze unchanged for independent later-January validation.
